name: Carol, the Elegance of Raise Moon
effectText: You can Normal Summon this card without Tributing, but its original ATK becomes 700. When you draw this card: You can reveal it; Special Summon this card. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned from the hand: You can draw 1 card, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except LIGHT Xyz Monsters. You cannot add cards from the Main Deck to your hand the turn you activate this effect, except by drawing them.
